extracted.intended_audience: mathematicians/authors submitting papers to Annales scientifiques de l'École normale supérieure
extracted.subtask_description: Instructions for authors submitting mathematical research papers to the Annales scientifiques de l'École normale supérieure, covering permitted languages, abstract and title translation requirements, and the electronic submission step.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accepted languages for papers
rubrics_metrics.description: The Annales scientifiques de l'École normale supérieure publish mathematical papers in French, English, German or Italian.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manuscripts submitted to the journal must be written in one of these four languages.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abstracts in French and English (150-word limit)
rubrics_metrics.description: Manuscripts submitted for publication should be sent together with an abstract in French and in English, of maximum length 150 words.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each submission must include two abstracts (French and English); each abstract must not exceed 150 words.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title translation requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles in French must be supplied with an English translation (French translations of the title/abstract can be delayed to the first revision request, if applicable). Titles in English, German or Italian should have a translation in French.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If the paper's title is in French, provide an English translation up front; if the title is in English, German or Italian, provide a French translation. French-language translations of title/abstract may be provided later at first revision if necessary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission format and account registration
rubrics_metrics.description: To submit a paper, please upload your pdf file here. You will first have to register if you do not have an account yet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions are done by uploading a PDF via the journal's submission system; authors must register for an account before uploading.
